request.task: Architect a default guided non-developer OneBox pipeline view while preserving the existing developer view and controller
request.head: e43513363384c3583034c0505c91184535918ef1

findings.scenario: An existing run.json has referenceSelection.status=selected with the current untagged shape {selectedId, selectionKind, version, at, note?} and no type field (ReferenceSelectionStateSchema today). Implementing the spec’s discriminated union as written (both arms require type: legacy-single-v1 | ranked-v1) makes RunStateSchema.parse fail. loadRun/resume then cannot read the durable machine, so existing picker runs cannot reconnect, invalidate reference-paused, or finalize the lock.
findings.remediation: Keep the on-disk untagged legacy object as a first-class parse arm. Accept z.union([currentSelectionSchema, z.object({type:'legacy-single-v1',...}), rankedV1Schema]). Tag/normalize in memory only inside one server helper; do not require type on historical bytes and do not rewrite run.json on read.

findings.scenario: After scanned=done the controller runs stageLockCandidates while stages.locked is still pending and referenceSelection is absent; later it runs stage('locked')/finalizeReferenceLock, stage('synthesized'), and the picker-disabled auto-lock path (referencePickerEnabled default false). None of these states appear in the matrix. The only catch-all is unknown → generic Review required, which would render normal candidate generation / synthesize / auto-lock as a review gate. Separately, guided step 2 'Understanding the leaders' and step 4 'Your design system' are never a Guided surface, so completed research has no authoritative mapping.
findings.remediation: Enumerate every current controller combination from executeEvidenceGatedPipeline/runPipeline (scanned done + locked pending/running ± referenceSelection, picker off, locked/synthesized/built failed, evidence draft generation, revision-requested, parked PageIR, cost-cap vs failed-stage precedence). Map each to a named surface and primary action. Define when steps 2 and 4 are current vs collapsed. Limit fail-closed Review required to truly unknown future terminals, not omitted known states.

findings.scenario: A guided confirm persists {type:'ranked-v1', preferences:[...]} with no selectedId. Unchanged developer/evidence clients and finalizeReferenceLock still parse selection as {selectedId, selectionKind, version, at}. GET /api/reference/:id and POST action=select idempotency (state.selection?.selectedId === input.selectedId) then either throw, show the picker again, or cannot build a lock — violating unchanged developer view and cross-mode resume.
findings.remediation: Make ranked-v1 additive: persist preferences plus derived compatibility fields (selectedId/version/selectionKind/note from rank 1). Keep legacy POST {action:'select', selectedId} working. Update only the shared normalizer, replay check, and finalizeReferenceLock to consume ranked form; do not require evidence UI changes to hide the picker.

findings.scenario: Client retries the same 1–3 notes/ranks with a new at (or a client-computed fingerprint). Spec stores at on ranked-v1 and treats fingerprint as SHA-256 of the canonical payload, but does not say the server computes it or excludes at/sourceMode. Comparison then 409s a true retry, or a client-supplied fingerprint makes two different payloads look identical.
findings.remediation: Server-assign at, checkpointId, sourceMode, and fingerprint. Fingerprint only canonical preferences+overallNote+checkpointId (sorted keys, trimmed notes). Identical retry = 200 if that digest matches; any other payload on a selected checkpoint = 409 with no mutation. Ignore client fingerprint/checkpointId.

findings.scenario: More than 4 sites pass eligibility. Spec says persist the complete analyzed set and display top four. ScanResultSchema.competitors.max(4) and stageScan(...slice(0,4)) will throw or drop the tail, so reconnect ranking/cardinality cannot be implemented on the supplied artifact.
findings.remediation: Do not overload scan.json. Add an additive analyzed-competitors artifact (or lift max with an explicit schema version) that stores every scored row, ranks, evidence refs, and displayCutoff=4. Keep legacy scan.json ≤4 parsable. Point the guided GET at that artifact.

findings.scenario: A fixture inverts Yelp/Maps rating and review count but those fields remain on PlaceSchema/CompetitorSchema and are passed into a model scorer. Excluding them only from the numeric total/tie-break does not stop the model from ranking by directory popularity while citing first-party text. The required inverted-Yelp test can pass the formula and still fail the product rule.
findings.remediation: Strip rating, userRatingCount, Yelp rank/review/rating, and directory rank from rubric model inputs. Score only crawled first-party text/structure plus persisted citations. Fixture must keep inverted directory fields present on the scan and assert they cannot change eligibility, rank, or tie-break.

findings.scenario: stageLock is specified to produce a ReferenceLock that includes an ordered preference ledger. ReferenceLockSchema today has no such field; making it required breaks parse of existing lock artifacts and in-flight runs. finalizeReferenceLock also currently forces borrowedDetails:[].
findings.remediation: Add optional preferenceLedger (default absent/empty) and map ranks 2–3 notes into existing borrowedDetails (max 2). Legacy locks keep parsing. Rank 1 remains primary; notes stay untrusted prose and cannot add competitor IDs/URLs to provenance.

findings.scenario: Guided default must collect 1–3 Refero choices, but RunState.referencePickerEnabled defaults false and referenceGateApplies() then auto-locks with no pause. The matrix has no picker-off row, so a first-time guided user never sees Choose your direction and cannot satisfy ranked selection without an unspecified controller flag change.
findings.remediation: Explicitly require new guided-eligible runs to set referencePickerEnabled=true (creation-time, immutable like today). Map picker-off/legacy runs to auto-lock surfaces (skip step 3, do not invent a chooser). Do not derive picker enablement from presentation mode.

findings.scenario: scanned failed, cost-cap during scan, or research-disabled empty scan all have to squeeze into researching|ready|unavailable. unavailable collides with missing Maps key and 0 eligible, so the matrix’s Research could not finish / recover action cannot be driven from the typed projection.
findings.remediation: Add status values (or a separate error class) for failed, disabled, and degraded-maps. Drive §5.4 surfaces from durable stage status + this projection, not from one overloaded unavailable flag.

findings.scenario: Ranked 3 preferences must flow into Page IR ReferenceContractV1 selection.sources (exactly one primary, max 3). The spec only describes ReferenceLock. A page-ir-v1 run can lock ranks 2–3 in the ledger and then drop them from IR sources, silently changing design influence by layout authority.
findings.remediation: Specify a single normalizer: rank 1 → role primary, ranks 2–3 → supporting, capped at maxReferenceSources=3, used by both finalizeReferenceLock and Page IR contract derivation.

audit.proof_assessment: The spec correctly keeps one controller, forbids a second pipeline/CSS-only hide, treats SSE as transport, persists rubric scores, requires confirm-before-resume, auth-bounds the research GET, and lists a11y/rollout/tests. It does not close the criterion: the selection union is not parse-compatible with current untagged run.json; the state-to-surface table omits real executeEvidenceGatedPipeline states (candidate generation before locked starts, synthesize, picker-off, failed lock/synth) while fail-closed would mislabel them; ranked-v1 is not additive to selectedId consumers; >4 persistence contradicts ScanResultSchema.max(4); idempotency/fingerprint and Yelp-exclusion are underspecified against the actual schemas and finalizeReferenceLock.
residual_risks: Two-step POST select then POST /api/run remains crash-windowy; reconnect must always resume from status=selected without a second confirm.
Home passing the event timeline into GuidedPipeline still invites prose parsing unless the guided read-model fetch is mandatory and tests forbid event-card oracles.
Canonical URL / first-party / social-only eligibility has no deterministic classifier against CompetitorSchema.url+kind, so 0-eligible outcomes may be brittle.
Evidence-workspace picker and guided chooser can both submit; server 409 must be the only cross-mode lock, including ranked-then-legacy and legacy-then-ranked.
